items.exampleEn: The manager is unavailable until three o'clock.
We returned the heater because it was faulty.
items.exampleZh: 我們把那台暖氣機退了，因為它有瑕疵。

items.exampleEn: My old car is so unreliable that I usually take the bus.
items.exampleZh: 我的舊車很不可靠，所以我通常搭公車。

items.exampleEn: We urgently need more staff for the weekend.
items.exampleZh: 我們週末急需更多人手。

items.exampleEn: We can conveniently pay all our bills online now.
items.exampleZh: 現在我們可以很方便地在網路上繳所有帳單。

items.exampleEn: The approximate cost of the trip is ten thousand dollars.
items.exampleZh: 這趟旅行的費用大約是一萬元。

items.exampleEn: Is there a particular day that works best for you?
items.exampleZh: 有沒有哪一天對你來說最方便？

items.exampleEn: Life on the farm was tough, especially in winter.
items.exampleZh: 農場生活很艱苦，尤其是冬天。

items.sentenceEn: The website is unavailable this morning because of repairs.
items.sentenceZh: 網站今天早上因為維修而無法使用。

items.audioEn: Please send the report urgently. The client needs it before noon.
items.audioZh: 請盡快把報告寄出。客戶中午以前就需要。
items.questionZh: 客戶什麼時候需要報告？

items.sentenceEn: The weather report has been unreliable all week.
items.sentenceZh: 這整週的天氣預報都不太可靠。

items.sentenceEn: Conveniently, the store was still open when we arrived.
items.sentenceZh: 很方便的是，我們到的時候店還開著。

items.stemEn: The phone stopped working after a week; it must be ____.
items.stemZh: 這支手機一週後就壞了；它一定有瑕疵。

items.stemEn: Can you give me the ____ number of guests? It doesn't have to be exact.
items.stemZh: 你可以告訴我大約有多少客人嗎？不必很精確。

items.passageEn: Dear Customer Service, Last month, I bought a coffee machine from your online store. Unfortunately, it was faulty: water leaked every time I used it. I called your help line several times, but it was always unavailable, so your service has been very unreliable. I need a replacement urgently, because I use the machine in my small cafe every day. Your store is not conveniently located for me, so I can't bring the machine back in person. Could you tell me the approximate time a new one would arrive? I have no particular problem with the price, but this has been a tough month for my business. Best regards, Olivia
items.passageZh: 客服部您好：上個月我在貴公司的網路商店買了一台咖啡機。很不幸，它有瑕疵：每次使用都會漏水。我打了好幾次客服專線，但一直沒人接，貴公司的服務實在很不可靠。我急需一台替換的機器，因為我的小咖啡店每天都要用。貴店的位置對我來說不方便，所以我沒辦法親自把機器拿回去。能否告訴我新機器大約什麼時候會送到？我對價格沒有特別的意見，但這個月我的生意真的很難熬。Olivia 敬上

questions.questionZh: 寫信的人遇到什麼問題？
options: 送來的咖啡機型號錯了

questions.questionZh: 她為什麼急著要一台新的機器？
options: 她下個月就要搬到別的城市
她的小咖啡店每天都要用

items.promptZh: 這是我做過最艱難的決定之一。
referenceEn: This is one of the toughest decisions I have ever made.
It was one of the toughest decisions I've ever made.
rubricZh: tough 表示「艱難的」，最高級是 toughest（例如 one of the toughest decisions）
「做過」可寫 I have ever made、I ever made、of my life 等；寫 hardest 也對

items.promptZh: 經理緊急把大家叫來開會。
referenceEn: The manager urgently called everyone to a meeting.
The manager urgently asked everyone to come to a meeting.
rubricZh: urgently 修飾動詞，可放動詞前或句尾（例如 urgently called 等）
「把大家叫來開會」可寫，例如 called everyone to a meeting、asked everyone to meet 等
時態可用過去式或現在完成式
